'''Freddy''' is an [[NPC]] found in the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}} who teaches the player how to [[Hunting|Hunt]] several different creatures.

{{/UI}}

|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fMy brother &aTeddy &fand I are some of the greatest hunters who have ever lived.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThis here &6Torrhus Canyon &fhas become a second home to me over the years.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIf you ever need tips on how to hunt any &a Critter &fon this here island, I’m yer man.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Ant}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fAnts&f?
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fHmm, them little fellas live down in &6Ant's Cave&f...
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThat thing's deep down in &bTorrhus Springs&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fBe sure to bring a &aVacuum &fwith ya - you'll need it to suck 'em up.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Beeheemoth}}s tip ({{Coins|20,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &5Beeheemoths&f? Even I dunno where they come from.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey just show up sometimes, yaknow? Flying high around the island.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fListen out for a loud humming and keep yer eyes peeled and &2Lasso &fat the ready, I'd say.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Blue Jay}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fBlue Jays&f? Them little guys live up in &6Torrhus Heights&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fClimb up high, &2Lasso &fin hand, and sneak up on 'em.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Bunbun}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fBunbuns&f? You ain't seen one yet?
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey're everywhere, hoppin' around!
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Drybark}}s tip ({{Coins|15,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem there &9Drybarks &fspawn from &6Helix Tree Gifts&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fKeep an eye on 'em while you get yer &2Lasso &fout.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fDon't blink, or they'll come right atcha.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Dustybit}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem frogs known as &aDustybits &fleap around the &6Spring Path&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fChase 'em down, following them after each leap, an' eventually they'll get too tired to run any more.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIt's a battle of attrition, I'll say, you versus the beast.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Ember}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem &aEmbers &flive in &bTorrhus Springs&f, I believe.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey be quite deep down, compared to &aSolars&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fCatch 'em all in yer &9Fishing Net&f.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Firefox}}es tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fPop open a &6Helix Tree Gift&f, ye might find a &fFirefox&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey be quite timid, and won't cause yer &2Lasso &fany problems.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Goldolot}}es tip ({{Coins|15,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fHmm, the &9Goldolot&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThat be a rare mutation of the &aSepialot &fthat sometimes appears in &bTorrhus Springs&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fI would say, hmm, maybe a &a20% &fchance o' replacin' it.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fSneak up on it and catch it in yer &9Fishing Net&f.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Groundhog}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIf I recall, them Groundhogs spawn from &6Helix Tree Gifts&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey're quite feisty, but use that there &2Lasso &fto tire 'em out.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Hideonsun}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fHideonsun&f, hmm, sneaky buggers.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fKeep yer eyes peeled for any strange lookin' &6Orange Boxes&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey blend into the environment real well.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fOnce ya find one, jump on its head or give it a punch to wake it up.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Hivethief}}s tip ({{Coins|15,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fI seen a &9Hivethief &for two show up sometimes.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey come by when you smear a &6Helix Tree &fwith &6Honeycomb&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fMe good friend &6Honey &fknows more about all that than me.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Honeybuzz}} tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fGroups of &fHoneybuzz &flive within &6Honeyhives &f'round the island.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fStick yer hand in and you might just find one!
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Mountain Goat}}s tip ({{Coins|20,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThe &5Mountain Goat &flive right up high.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fOn the &6Spring Path &fand other tall points is where you'll find 'em.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fKeep yer distance when you &2Lasso &f'em, though - their headbutt will send yer flying.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Pangolin}}s tip ({{Coins|15,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem &9Pangolins &fbe right scared of their own shadow, I tell ya.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fSneak up on 'em, quiet as you can, and &2Lasso &f'em before they can turn into a ball.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIf they do curl up, yer gonna have to wait a while until they let their guard down again.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Parched}} tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem &aParched &fbe really thirsty.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIf you smear a &6Helix Tree &fwith &6Honey&f, they might show up.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThe lovely &6Honey &fknows more about all that stuff than I do.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Pollendart}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThem &fPollendarts &flove their &6Honey&f, I know that much!
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIf you smear a &6Helix Tree &fwith &6Honey&f, they might come.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fMiss &6Honey &fknows more about all that than I do. Ask her!
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Puck}}s tip ({{Coins|15,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fOpen up a &6Helix Tree Gift&f, ye might find a &9Puck&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey be mischievous little buggers, but they ain't as strong as a well-placed &2Lasso&f, I can tell yer that much.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Queen Ant}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fAh, the &aQueen Ant&f. A special one, she is.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fDive deep down into &bTorrhus Springs&f, make yer way into &6Ant's Cave&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fYou'll rarely find her scuttlin' about on the cave floor.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fShe's more likely to come out if ya start destroyin' the &eAnthills&f, though.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Sepialot}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &aSepialot&f, huh, that thing be up in &bTorrhus Springs&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fSneak up on it and catch it in yer &9Fishing Net &fbefore it sees ya.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | Tiki Trios tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fHur hur hur hurr! That &aTiki Trio&f, I hate 'em, I really do!
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThe &aSneaky Tiki&f, &aShrieky Tiki&f, and &aCheeky Tiki&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fI can't tell ya which one I hate the most. But I can tell ya which one I hate the least - none of 'em!
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fYou can find 'em up in &6Torrhus Heights&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey'll stay still, unmovin', until you solve their puzzle.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThen they'll come to life and blitz 'ya.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fFend 'em off, and catch 'em in a &cPocket Black Hole&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fAh, just thinkin 'bout them has me blood boilin'...
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Solar}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fEh, them &aSolars &flive in &bTorrhus Springs&f, too.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey be needing light to function, so they be up near the surface.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fScoop em up in yer &9Fishing Net&f.
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Timil}}s tip ({{Coins|5,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fAre ye blind, kid?
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fTurn around and look into that there &9Pond&f!
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fIt's completely overflowin' with &fTimil&f!
}}
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" | {{MobSprite|Water Snake}}s tip ({{Coins|10,000}})
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &aWater Snakes&f, huh...
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fThey be livin in the deepest depths of &bTorrhus Springs&f.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fGet all of yer best divin' gear on, and them pay 'em a visit.
&e[NPC] &aFreddy&f: &fBring yer biggest net, too - a &5Turbo Fishing Net &for better should do the trick.
}}
|}
